rows.Synonyms:
• DELroufra
• La Rose des 4 Vents
• Simply Stunning
rows.ARS:
Dark red Hybrid Tea.
Exhibition name: La Rose des 4 Vents
rows.Origin:
Bred by G. Delbard (France, 2005).
Introduced in New Zealand by Matthews Nurseries Ltd. in before 2013 as 'Simply Stunning'.
rows.Bloom: Carmine-red. . Mild, raspberry fragrance. Average diameter 4". Large, double (17-25 petals), borne mostly solitary, cupped, scalloped bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Tall. Dark green foliage.

Height: 31" to 39" (80 to 100cm). Width: 20" to 2' (50 to 60cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 10b. Blooms tend to ball in wet weather.
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
